adds.rationale: Intuitive Machines' Odysseus lander achieved the first US soft landing on the Moon in over 50 years and the first-ever commercial lunar landing, a concrete milestone that puts direct exposure to the profile's #1-ranked next wave (Moon/asteroid resources) on the watchlist alongside RKLB and PL.

removes.rationale: AAPL now carries a dated regulatory overhang (DOJ monopoly suit) and a documented iPhone/China sales decline, with no comparable generative-AI product story to the MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA names already anchoring the AI wave bucket, so it is the weakest link to trim to stay under the watchlist cap while adding LUNR.

news_evidence.summary: DOJ, joined by 15 states and DC, files a Sherman Act Section 2 monopolization suit against Apple over iPhone platform control and App Store fees; stock down 7.2% YTD partly on the suit
Fiscal Q2 2024 iPhone revenue fell to $45.96B from $51.33B a year earlier, with Greater China representing a larger share of the decline

rationale_overall: Net effect is a like-for-like swap that keeps the watchlist at the 16-ticker cap while sharpening thematic focus: AAPL exits on a dated regulatory breach (DOJ monopoly suit) and a weak Q1 iPhone/China print that leaves it poorly linked to the dominant AI wave next to MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA, and LUNR enters rockets_spacecraft on the back of Intuitive Machines' historic Feb-2024 lunar landing, deepening exposure (with RKLB, PL) to the profile's named next-wave Moon/asteroid-resource thesis. All other positions (defense LMT/ITA, nuclear LEU/CCJ, quantum IONQ, robotics ISRG/BOTZ, tanker STNG, eldercare CTRE, core AI MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA, and SPY) show intact or strengthening theses this quarter (e.g., ~$100/lb uranium, Red Sea-driven tanker rate spikes, LMT's record $160.6B backlog, ISRG's 21% procedure growth) and are kept unchanged; no wave bucket exceeds the 4-ticker diversity guardrail.
